issues: Obserrian Advisor side drawer can auto-open and overlay right-column KPI cards (Article 14 overdue, AI grounding score), intercepting real user clicks on those KPIs. Consider auto-collapsing the drawer on the Executive Overview or lowering its z-index over KPI grid.
